description: PostShiba is an email infrastructure service for developers and SaaS platforms that send and receive email on behalf of their customers. It supports outbound sending, inbound mail handling, domains, tenants, clusters, templates, and webhooks.
summary: PostShiba exposes a Bearer-token REST API at `api.postshiba.com` and a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `app.postshiba.com/mcp`; docs also mention SMTP and a CLI, but the scraped pages did not expose enough concrete authentication mechanics to record them confidently.
